name: Gideon of the Trials
oracle_text:
+1: Until your next turn, prevent all damage target permanent would deal.
0: Until end of turn, Gideon becomes a 4/4 Human Soldier creature with indestructible that's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.
0: You get an emblem with "As long as you control a Gideon planeswalker, you can't lose the game and your opponents can't win the game."
blocked_sentences: +1: Until your next turn, prevent all damage target permanent would deal.
Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.

needs.what: an op that prevents all damage a chosen (targeted) permanent would deal, to any recipient, for a duration
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The 'prevent_damage' op shields only a player (takes 'duration' and 'player', rejects 'objects'); the 'prevent_damage' static is a shield on damage dealt TO the static's affected objects, not damage dealt BY a target, and cannot be created by a resolving loyalty ability

needs.what: a duration 'until your next turn' for the source-prevention effect above
needs.why_existing_wont_do: playable_durations are end_of_your_next_turn, later_turns, this_turn, while_exiled, your_next_end_step; none ends at the start of your next turn

needs.what: an op that prevents all damage that would be dealt to a permanent (here the source itself) this turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The 'prevent_damage' op only shields a player and its loader rejects 'objects'; the 'prevent_damage' static lives on a permanent's printed abilities and cannot be granted until end of turn by a resolving ability
